title: The size of the home you experience is weighted by its residents
body: Pew's 2019 study of living arrangements reported household size from a person's perspective. A six-person home counts for six people in that average, while a person living alone counts once.
takeaway: The typical person can live in a larger home than a count of typical households would suggest.
source: Pew Research Center, Religion and Living Arrangements Around the World (2019)
visual: a cross-section of two homes, one with a family dining together and one with a lone resident

title: Most married Indians in one survey shared a spouse's religion
body: In a 2021 Pew report based on interviews in India, 99% of married respondents said their spouse shared their religion. The figure came from people's own accounts of their marriage.
takeaway: A country can be religiously diverse at the national scale while most households are formed within a faith group.
source: Pew Research Center, Religion in India: Tolerance and Segregation (2021)
visual: two adults sitting across from one another on a shaded veranda
